pricing_engine.advisor.suggestion.basket: Delivering {mergedLineCount} more lines on the same drop pays the per-order handling and the delivery stop once instead of twice. Priced separately the orders come to {separateTotalNet} {currency}; merged they come to {mergedTotalNet} {currency}, and the unit price falls from {unitPriceBefore} to {unitPriceAfter} {currency}.
Merge these orders into one delivery
pricing_engine.advisor.suggestion.cheape: A product group is a category, not a list of substitutes. Confirm with the customer that the two products do the same job before you offer this.

{toSku} sits in the same group ({productGroupCode}) as {fromSku} and costs less to buy, which takes the unit price from {unitPriceBefore} to {unitPriceAfter} {currency} — a saving of {unitPriceSaving} {currency} a unit.
A cheaper product in the same group
pricing_engine.advisor.suggestion.fullPa: {toQuantity} units is a whole {packUnitCode} of {packFactor}. Rounding up from {fromQuantity} takes the unit price from {unitPriceBefore} to {unitPriceAfter} {currency} and your profit on the order from {basketProfitBefore} to {basketProfitAfter} {currency}.

Rounding {fromQuantity} up to {toQuantity} fills a whole {packUnitCode} of {packFactor}, but the extra pack costs more to make up than the larger order saves: the unit price rises by {unitPriceDelta} {currency}. Your profit on the order still moves from {basketProfitBefore} to {basketProfitAfter} {currency}.
Round up to a whole pack
pricing_engine.advisor.suggestion.orderC: Taking this customer's orders through {toScenario} instead of {fromScenario} cuts {unitCostSaving} {currency} of handling cost from every unit. The order total falls from {basketTotalBefore} to {basketTotalAfter} {currency}.
Move this customer to a cheaper ordering channel
pricing_engine.advisor.suggestion.volume: Raising this line from {fromQuantity} to {toQuantity} units drops the unit price from {unitPriceBefore} to {unitPriceAfter} {currency}, a saving of {unitPriceSaving} {currency} a unit, because the cost of handling an order is fixed and spreads over more units. Your profit on the order moves from {basketProfitBefore} to {basketProfitAfter} {currency}.

Raising this line from {fromQuantity} to {toQuantity} units drops the unit price from {unitPriceBefore} to {unitPriceAfter} {currency} and moves your profit on the order from {basketProfitBefore} to {basketProfitAfter} {currency}. It also carries your annual purchases past the {nextTierVolume}-unit threshold, where your own supplier discount rises to {nextTierDiscount}%.
Order more and pay less per unit
